hooks.name: Lint and test reminder for app code
hooks.description: Remind the agent to run lint and the app tests after UI or logic changes. One Gradle command at a time.

action.prompt: An app/ Kotlin file changed. Before you finish, run ./gradlew :app:testDebugUnitTest --no-daemon, then ./gradlew lintDebug --no-daemon, one at a time. If the change touches the throttle (ThrottleCoordinator, ThrottleController use), say what was measured and what was not. Do not claim the throttle works without a number.

hooks.name: Throttle claim check
hooks.description: Stop the agent from claiming speed results it did not measure.

action.prompt: Check your last answer. If it says the throttle or detection works, name the test or measurement behind it. If there is none, say so plainly.
